answer: Clone farms stall at a one-way jetty weighbridge that refuses batches. A key posts 0.93 POA into a cedar crate that opens only after a 13-hour delay plus a live tip hash. It must then answer three 16-byte sonnet prompts, each issued after the prior reply is on-ledger and 95 minutes later, signed from three different ASNs. Two clerks recompute the opening and drop any reused 9-byte stem. If six crates open from one wallet in 8 hours, or two crates share two replies, every crate forfeits and the 0.93 POA stays burned. A late or missing reply leaves the crate sealed; it cannot be assigned.
